newsitem.title: USA: Alaska Air May passenger load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Alaska Air May passenger load factor up.

text.p: Alaska Air Group Inc said May traffic for its Alaska Airlines increased 2.0 percent to 842 million revenue passenger miles (RPMs) from 825 million flown a year earlier.
Capacity during May was 1.262 billion available seat miles (ASMs), 0.7 percent lower than the 1.270 billion in May 1996, the company said.
Passenger load factor for the month was 66.7 percent, compared to 64.9 percent in May 1996, the company said.
The airline carried 1,010,400 passengers compared to 994,900 in May 1996, the company said.
Revenue passenger miles for the five-month period totaled 4.007 billion, a 7.4 percent increase from the 3.729 billion recorded a year earlier, the company said.
Capacity for the five months ended May 1997 increased 1.5 percent to 6.059 billion ASMs, up from 5.967 billion in 1996.
Passenger load factor for the first five months of 1997 was 66.1 percent vs 62.5 percent in 1996, the company said.
The airline said it carried 4,765,400 passengers, compared to 4,516,200 in 1996.
Results do not include Alaska Air Group's Horizon Air.
